verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions native ClickUp Dashboards or widgets. The only reporting evidence is a third-party integration listing for 'Instant Analytics and Automated Reports for ClickUp' and an MCP use case where an external AI assistant builds executive status reports and portfolio summaries. Both give project-progress reporting only through extra tools, so this is partial at best. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of native dashboards, configurable widgets for progress reporting, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
